11:             postings[event['id']] = (account, amount)
12:             totals.setdefault(account, 0)
13:             if event['id'] in pending_retractions:
14:                 del pending_retractions[event['id']]
15:             else:
16:                 totals[account] += amount
17:         else:
18:             target = event['target']
19:             if target in cancelled:
20:                 continue
21:             cancelled.add(target)
22:             if target in postings:
23:                 account, amount = postings[target]
24:                 totals[account] -= amount
25:             else:
26:                 pending_retractions[target] = True
27:     return totals
